args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-definition hand-painted RTS game unit atlas, original Daoist chibi mechanical designs for Mindustry v160.7 art adaptation. The two attached images are PRIMARY art-style references ONLY: borrow their refined painted jade-green, ivory enamel, warm gold/brass, rounded cloud ornament, gentle shading, precise material finish. Do not copy the UI, people, text, scenery or frames. No humans.
Critical camera: ALL units are strict orthographic TOP-DOWN, looking straight down at their dorsal surfaces, nose and weapon barrels oriented straight UP (north). Never front-facing portraits or isometric side views. Bilateral machinery and complete silhouettes, no cast ground shadows. Clear restrained hand-painted 2D shading, no plastic 3D toys, no pixel art.
Layout: requested native 3072×2048 canvas, landscape 3:2. EXACTLY FIVE SEPARATE complete units in equal 3-column by 2-row invisible cells: top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center; bottom-right EMPTY transparent. Each silhouette wholly contained within its own cell with generous 12% margins/gutters, equal visual presentation size with tier-dependent complexity. No overlap across cells. No grid lines, labels, numbers, symbols outside objects, panels, backdrop, swatches or captions.
Transparent output: genuine RGBA transparent background in every outside gap; no checkerboard or colored matte. Clean opaque object surfaces, crisp antialiased edges, no detached particles, halos or stray colored specks. Avoid tiny floating tassels; restrained Daoist motifs integrated into solid armor and mechanisms.

Objects in exact reading order:
1. MONO T1: small friendly mining drone, round jade gourd engine body, two short stabilizer fins, one tiny forward mining drill/tool, compact rear thruster; no weapons.
2. POLY T2: rebuilding drone with four short diagonal ivory arms, forward repair emitter, small construction claws, green jade core and practical bronze tool inlets.
3. MEGA T3: broad winged repair cargo lifter, central visible cargo socket, two paired small repair-beam turrets, substantial articulated carrying arms and four compact engines.
4. QUAD T4: heavy four-wing bomber and transport drone, broad square-rounded symmetrical body, central bomb payload bay, four engine nacelles and strong bronze armor.
5. OCT T5: gigantic eightfold round-edged shield-support carrier, eight evenly spaced jade shield projector nodes around the hull, vast central cargo bay, ivory/brass outer armor and rear engines; visibly support-oriented, no attack cannons.
Do not print the English identifiers; they only specify distinct identities. Show equipment attached in neutral forward pose. Complete unclipped silhouettes; preserve functional differences. Target configured GPT Image 2.5 highest quality.
